summary: Students who upload their own notes or PDFs want AI summaries, flashcards and quizzes that stay within that material and have correct answer keys.

evidence.claim: 12 dated complaints (Feb to Nov 2026) of AI study tools adding outside content, errors and wrong answer keys across 6 apps (Turbolearn, StudyFetch, Studley, Noji, Quizlet, Knowt). Substitute pressure from NotebookLM and ChatGPT noted by reviewers.
evidence.source: state/scout/2026-11-17-education-b.json (edu-b2; each quote has an Apple review RSS URL and date)

history.note: kept: capability gap (source fidelity) across 6 apps
